rootCause: Markdown uses the DOM renderer; the scroll-table flag on the mp-html fallback does not create scroll containers in that path. Grid tables exceed the clipped reader viewport.
change: Each normalized table uses a native horizontal scroll-view. Width stays within the parent; table cells retain normal size and source order. Fixed-width tables do not scale the entire page. Hidden tables remain hidden.
platform: Actual reader file-open and compiled production WXML in official glass-easel with Chrome DOM backend; scroll-view browser adapter. Not a WeChat native gesture test.
limitations: Original qin-bear SVG is still unavailable; this fix does not claim to resolve that separate report.
Raw nested HTML tables expose a separate existing parser boundary defect; retained for the next investigation.
